set system host-name SPE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols ldp interface all.explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ldp router-id 1.1.1.9.explanation: Configure the LDP protocol router ID.

set protocols mpls interface all.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ospf area 0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface ge-0/0/1.0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

set routing-instances vfi-v100.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

instance-type vpls.explanation: Configure the type of route example that is a virtual router.

parameters.name: instance-type
parameters.explanation: Type of route example, e.g. virtual-router.

set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.template: set routing-instances [parameter1] protocols vpls neighbor [parameter2] pw-id [parameter3]
set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.command: set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols vpls neighbor 3.3.3.9 pw-id 300
set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.explanation: 配置VPLS实例的邻居及其PW ID。

parameters.name: pw-id
parameters.explanation: 伪线ID，用于标识VPLS实例中的伪线。

set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.template: set routing-instances [parameter1] protocols vpls neighbor [parameter2] pw-id [parameter3]
set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.command: set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols vpls neighbor 4.4.4.9 pw-id 200
set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.explanation: 配置VPLS实例的邻居及其PW ID。

parameters.name: pw-id
parameters.explanation: 伪线ID，用于标识VPLS实例中的伪线。

set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols.command: set routing-instances vfi-v100 protocols vpls mac-withdraw
